name: The numeral 'three' — a place, folded into a name
description: Peirce: a diagram is a TYPE, and can only be shown through a replica of it — a TOKEN. So it is with a numeral. '3' is not an object the sheet contains; it is the third position in the order, and the numeral is a *definition* that folds that chain into one spot and unfolds it back again, losing nothing (the fold is checked conservative by same_graph). This is why arithmetic can be practical and logical at once: the numeral is a working abbreviation, and the logic underneath it is always recoverable — one click of 'unfold'.
